resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and Forest Fire Lookout Association list Coconino County, and Wikidata's location statement agrees. A Wikidata photo file is titled Mohave County, near Frazier Wells. The story uses Coconino per the register and notes the photo title.

notes_for_editor: Nearly all of the history rests on one register entry, plus Wikidata for the county. No newspaper, Forest Service or tribal source was found, and the latest staffing date is 2011. Access is listed as unknown: the story says no public visitor information was found, and it does not infer permission rules. Photo candidates not added: a 2008 Panoramio photo on Wikidata (license not checked) and the register's 2008 photo credited to Chris English (license not stated). Three web searches were run for this lookout, one over the two-search budget.
